_comment: An ordinary BT session intake for scripts/expert-vs-catalog.mjs. No PHI. Written the way a technician actually writes one, casual causal language and unexpanded abbreviations included, because an intake cleaned up for the bench would only prove that a clean intake reads clean.
fSession:
- BCBA in room first 15 min
- Came in tired, wanted the tablet right away, kind of grumpy about starting
- Ran tx plan goals plus BIP
fLesson:
- Receptive ID in DTT, 3-item array, started errorless and faded to gestural, got 2 independent by the end
- Tact training in NET during play, around 70%
- MT program still hard, mostly needed FP
fAntecedent:
- First/then board before each transition
- 1 min warnings
- Gave choice of work order
- Turned off the overhead light, seemed to help him settle
fBehavior:
- Elopement x2, blocked and redirected, no escalation
- Prompted 'break please', gave the break, behavior stopped
- He was doing it for attention I think, once I sat closer it dropped off
- Better than last week
fFollowUp:
- Ask BCBA about updating the elopement protocol
- Need a new visual schedule printed
